# Load Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(randomForest)
library(survival)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Preparing

```{r}
# Load SKCM expression object
load("SKCM.rda")

clinical <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(bcr_patient_barcode, gender, vital_status, days_to_death,
         ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time  = days_to_death / 365,
    event          = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis  = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event))

log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

matched <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched]
```

# Feature Selection

```{r}
top1k    <- names(sort(apply(log_expr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:1000]
expr_filt <- log_expr[top1k, ]
expr_mat  <- t(expr_filt)

rf_data <- as.data.frame(expr_mat) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
    event         = clinical$event
  )
```

# Split data

```{r}
set.seed(42)
evt_idx   <- which(rf_data$event == 1)
cen_idx   <- which(rf_data$event == 0)
train_idx <- c(
  sample(evt_idx, round(0.7 * length(evt_idx))),
  sample(cen_idx, round(0.7 * length(cen_idx)))
)
test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(rf_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- rf_data[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- rf_data[test_idx, ]
```

# Train Random Forest

```{r}
rf_model <- randomForest(
  survival_time ~ .,
  data  = train_data %>% select(-event),
  ntree = 100,
  importance = TRUE
)

# get median risk threshold from training set
train_data$pred_train       <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_data)
rf_median_score             <- median(train_data$pred_train, na.rm = TRUE)

# apply to test set
test_data$predicted <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)

```

# Evaluate Model

```{r}
# C-index
c_index <- concordance(
  Surv(test_data$survival_time, test_data$event) ~ test_data$predicted
)$concordance

# 1-year ROC/AUC
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    surv_1yr = ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event == 1, 1, 0),
    valid    = survival_time >= 1 | (survival_time < 1 & event == 1)
  )

labels    <- test_data$surv_1yr[test_data$valid]
scores    <- test_data$predicted[test_data$valid]
valid_idx <- complete.cases(labels, scores)

roc_obj <- roc(labels[valid_idx], scores[valid_idx], direction = "<")
auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
```

# Output Table and Plot

```{r}
metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("C-index", "AUC (1-Year)"),
  Value  = c(round(c_index, 3), round(auc_val, 3))
)
knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "Random Forest Performance")

print(
  ggroc(roc_obj) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      title    = "ROC (1-Year Mortality)",
      subtitle = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3))
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
)
```

```{r}
save(rf_model, rf_median_score, file = "rf.RData")
```
